risk_note: RV2, settlement clawback + app.module wiring, no migration, no contract change, no money moves (withdraw lane, model Claude Fable 5.1; orchestrator rulings D10-583, D10-753 ④, D10-792, D10-844). An R9 valued on a rights deduction (settlement's rights.record → clawback apply with ref rights; N_new = booked_n − deduction, BR-FUND-08 ②) moved no order column, so the sync never moved commission_version and the latest amount rows and four amounts stayed at the pre-clawback entitlement (gross-profit reports and risk labels reading the rows were too high; wallet and order pages read ledger nets and were right). Now apply moves the version in the same CAS as the booked pair (optimistic guard commission_version = the value read under the lock, BR-CALC-15) and asks commission's estimates.refresh to write that version's rows valued on N_new — the R7 entry of B2-03r, once per version, no balance touched. R8 writes no rows; a replayed R9 with no change moves nothing; the R9 / R10 brought by the sync are still moved once by orders. estimates is an optional dependency of the clawback because three frozen kits build it without one (the production assembly always injects the same commission port as the rebate port's), so no frozen kit or test changed. Real risks: a double version move for the sync-driven R9 / R10 (covered: [AC-B2-04zk#5] / [#6]), a move on redelivery (covered: #3), rows for a terminal R8 (covered: #4), a partial write on a downstream failure (covered: #7), cross-app leakage (covered: #8). The premise ran before the ledger change: with the change applied on top of B2-04zi, spec/settlement + spec/commission (1371 tests) and spec/orders + invite-reward + risk-flags (1824 tests) showed no new frozen conflict. The rule-test kit needed one mechanical type fix (D10-844: the versionWrites parameter typed structurally, the then-unused CompiledQuery type import dropped), made by the lane in its own commit, outside the test-round count. Test-machine full verify not run (AWS runners disabled, D10-555; CI verify-int is the full verification, approvals 21); the red run and the implementation's runs were made in the local Docker container / host slot.
